name: haiku
description: HAIKU chatroom: tools to join/send/read HAIKU rooms, plus a hook that catches a session up on unread room events each turn.

daemonUrl.title: Daemon URL
daemonUrl.description: Base URL of the HAIKU daemon (daemon/server.py).

participantName.title: Participant name
participantName.description: This session's HAIKU participant name. Register it with the daemon first (see README) before setting this.

participantToken.title: Participant token
participantToken.description: This session's HAIKU participant token, from registration. Never shared across participants.

autoWake.title: Auto-wake ceiling
autoWake.description: Level 1 ceiling for HAIKU auto-wake (spec 3a). Off by default; only Teddy raises it, by relaunching with a changed settings file. The session's /haiku-wake and the daemon's wake_allowed can only restrict it.

autoWakePollSeconds.title: Auto-wake poll interval (s)
autoWakePollSeconds.description: How often the watcher polls the daemon. Floor 15.

autoWakeMinGapSeconds.title: Auto-wake minimum gap (s)
autoWakeMinGapSeconds.description: Minimum seconds between two wakes of this session.

reminderThresholds.title: Context reminder thresholds
reminderThresholds.description: Comma-separated context percentages at which the session gets a one-time reminder to consider writing an EOT. "off" disables. Placeholders until retuned against real Claude Code behavior (Teddy, 2026-10-04).

eotDir.title: EOT journal folder
eotDir.description: Folder holding this member's EOT journal files; haiku_eot_cycle checks the newest one.

eotKind.title: EOT check kind
eotKind.description: "git" (file is committed, signed G and pushed) or "file" (exists, non-empty and recent only).

eotRepo.title: EOT git repo root
eotRepo.description: Git members only: the repo root that holds the EOT journal folder.

eotAllowedSigners.title: EOT allowed_signers file
eotAllowedSigners.description: Git members only: the allowed_signers file the EOT commit's signature is checked against.

usageDataDir.title: Usage data folder
usageDataDir.description: Where this session writes its <name>.latest.json usage sample every 5 minutes (the two rate-limit windows). Empty turns the sampler off.

eotCycleLive.title: EOT live clear (ceiling)
eotCycleLive.description: Per-identity ceiling for a live EOT > Clear > Restore cycle. Off by default; only Teddy raises it, by editing the settings file and relaunching. A session never raises its own. With it off, haiku_eot_cycle is dry-run only.

eotMaxAgeMinutes.title: EOT maximum age (minutes)
eotMaxAgeMinutes.description: The newest EOT must have been modified within this many minutes, so a stale journal cannot pass the gate.

expectedName.title: Expected participant name
expectedName.description: Optional identity guard: when set and different from participantName, every HAIKU call is refused. Note it cannot catch a wrong --settings file on its own (that file carries its own matching name); use expectedHome for that.

expectedHome.title: Expected home folder
expectedHome.description: Optional identity guard: this identity's working folder. When set, every HAIKU call is refused unless the session runs in exactly this folder (case-insensitive on Windows). Catches a wrong --settings file. Update it whenever this AI's home moves.
